title: Sable and the Blue Hour
author: Noor Vasquez
blurb: Zephyrine Kavanagh, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
